_comment: world.yaml under a copy's identity (uid "new", source "old"): the cases both rewrites must pass, the server's (internal/modules/world/save.go, withCopyIdentity; save_test.go) and the browser's (client/src/world/worldCopy.ts; npm run harness:roundtrip). want null: refused.

cases.name: the uid replaced, other annotations kept, the source replaced
cases.in:
apiVersion: casas-eternas/v1alpha1
kind: FlatWorld
metadata:
  name: a
  uid: old
  annotations:
    example/note: kept
    casas-eternas/copied-from: older
spec:
  seed: s
cases.want:
apiVersion: casas-eternas/v1alpha1
kind: FlatWorld
metadata:
  name: a
  uid: new
  annotations:
    example/note: kept
    casas-eternas/copied-from: old
spec:
  seed: s

cases.name: a key with a dot stays in the block
cases.in:
apiVersion: casas-eternas/v1alpha1
kind: FlatWorld
metadata:
  name: a
  uid: old
  annotations:
    example.com/x: one
    casas-eternas/copied-from: older
    example.com/y: two
spec:
  seed: s
cases.want:
apiVersion: casas-eternas/v1alpha1
kind: FlatWorld
metadata:
  name: a
  uid: new
  annotations:
    example.com/x: one
    example.com/y: two
    casas-eternas/copied-from: old
spec:
  seed: s

  uid: old
  annotations:
      example.com/x: one
      casas-eternas/copied-from: older
      example/z: three

  seed: s
cases.want:
apiVersion: casas-eternas/v1alpha1

metadata:
  name: a
  uid: new

  seed: s

cases.in:
apiVersion: casas-eternas/v1alpha1
kind: FlatWorld
metadata:
  name: a
  uid: old
spec:
  seed: s
cases.want:

cases.name: no uid, a quoted value, a key after the annotations
cases.in:
apiVersion: casas-eternas/v1alpha1
kind: FlatWorld
metadata:
  name: a
  annotations:
    example/note: "a: b"
  generation: 3
spec:
  seed: s
cases.want:
apiVersion: casas-eternas/v1alpha1
kind: FlatWorld
metadata:
  name: a
  generation: 3
  uid: new
  annotations:
    example/note: "a: b"
    casas-eternas/copied-from: old
spec:
  seed: s

cases.name: no metadata block: no world to copy
